state:
Goal `core-sse-and-2-more`. `Core\Sse::current`, `retry`, `receive` and `send`, and both `Core\Sse\Message`
members (`topic`, `value`), now have all their feature proofs on disk: examples under
`docs/examples/core/Sse/` and `docs/examples/core/Sse-Message/`, attacks under `tests/hostile/core/Sse*/`,
benches under `benches/members/core/Sse*/` with fresh perf records, and `covers:` Rust tests in
`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/sse.rs`. `Core\Sse\Message` has its class card. A proof that needs a connection
isolate takes a `<name>.nvse` beside it (`docs/examples/README.md` § *Values published to an event stream*).
`Core\Sse::stream` and `Core\Sse::upgrade` still owe examples, attack and bench (`stream` has its Rust
`covers:` test; `upgrade` owes a third test case), and `Core\Storage` owes everything but its Rust tests
and a card. The rendered rules page is current again, and a hostile verdict now quotes the stderr line
that carried the crash marker (`tools/nv/proofs/run.ts`), because the one `Core\Serialize` attack failure
the last sweep saw did not reproduce in three uncached runs.

items.text: **`Core\Sse::stream` proofs** — `rule:testing/feature-proofs`: `about.md`, three examples, one attack, one bench; the member is `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/sse.rs:597` and its card `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/sse.rs:306`. A plain run prints the stream's events to standard output, so no `.nvse` is needed; the status refusal is one example (`Core\Response::setStatus` first).

**`Core\Sse::upgrade` proofs** — `rule:testing/feature-proofs`: the member is `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/sse.rs:535` and its card `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/sse.rs:264`. Off a server it throws `RuntimeError`, so an example can show that refusal. Check what `bun nv proofs --id 'Core\Sse::upgrade'` says the third test case needs before writing it.

**`Core\Storage` class card, then `get`, `delete` and `list` proofs** — `rule:core-api/reference-card`: a `ClassDoc` for `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/storage.rs:168` (its `doc: None` is at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/storage.rs:170`), and drop `Core\Storage` from `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/registry.rs:5283`. Members at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/storage.rs:514`, `:534`, `:552`. This is a new file set, so it starts a session of its own.

backlog: The `Core\Serialize` attack `tests/hostile/core/Serialize/encode/01-deep-chains-loops-and-hidden-closures.nvs` failed once in the driver's sweep with `stderr carries "RUST_BACKTRACE"` and no `panicked at`; if it shows again, the verdict now quotes the line — read it before touching the case (`tools/nv/proofs/run.ts`).
